items.title: 19.1 Mass defect aur binding energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of mass defect, binding energy and binding energy per nucleon (PDF 138-140, printed 134-136).

blocks.text: Alag alag nuclei ke mass napne ke experiments (tajurbe) batate hain ke nucleus ka mass hamesha us ke tamam protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se kam hota hai. Is kam (gum hone wale) mass ko mass defect Δm kehte hain:

Yahan mₚ proton ka mass, mₙ neutron ka mass aur m_nucleus poore nucleus ka mass hai (Z protons aur A − Z neutrons). Yeh gum hua mass energy mein badal kar nucleus banane mein kharch hua. Yeh energy Einstein ke mass-energy relation se nikalti hai:
Yeh energy nucleus ki potential energy hai jise Binding Energy (B.E) kehte hain. Is ki definition (tareef):

blocks.title: Binding Energy
blocks.text: Nucleus ko us ke constituents (hisson), yani neutrons aur protons, mein todne ke liye nucleus par jitna kaam (work) karna parta hai, use binding energy kehte hain.

Binding energy ko negative maana jata hai, bilkul gravitational potential ki tarah jo infinity (bohat door) par zero li jati hai: bandhe hue nucleus ki energy alag alag nucleons ki energy se kam hoti hai. Stability (mazbooti) ka behtar measure (paimana) binding energy per nucleon hai, yani nucleus ko alag alag nucleons (neutrons aur protons) mein todne ke liye har nucleon par average (ausatan) kitni energy chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke absolute gravitational potential 'zameen ki satah par' zero liya jata hai; sahi yeh hai ke woh infinity par zero liya jata hai (isi liye bandhi hui energies negative hoti hain).
Sub-atomic particles ke mass aam taur par atomic mass unit (amu ya u) mein likhe jate hain. 1 u carbon-12 (¹²₆C) ke ek unbound (azad, kisi se na jura) atom ke mass ka barahwan (1/12) hissa hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 1 u ko '²₆C' ke atom ke mass ka '1/112th' likhti hai. Sahi: 1 u carbon-12 (¹²₆C) atom ke mass ka 1/12 hai.

blocks.alt: Protons (+) aur neutrons ka nucleus, 'Nucleus (smaller mass)', jama 'Binding energy' ka dabba, teer ke baad wahi protons aur neutrons alag alag bikhre hue, 'Separated nucleons (greater mass)'.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: nucleus ko us ke protons aur neutrons mein todne ke liye energy deni parti hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nucleus ko torne ke liye binding energy bahar se deni parti hai. Is liye alag alag nucleons ka kul mass (greater mass) nucleus ke mass (smaller mass) se zyada hota hai; yahi farq mass defect hai.

blocks.title: Example 19.1
blocks.problem: Helium nucleus ka mass defect aur binding energy nikalein. Diya gaya: mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, nucleus ka mass = 6.646786 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
steps: Helium nucleus mein 2 protons aur 2 neutrons hain: Δm = 2mₚ + 2mₙ − m_nucleus
Einstein ki equation: B.E = Δmc² = 0.048318 × 10⁻²⁷ kg × (3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 4.34862 × 10⁻¹² J
blocks.answer: B.E = 27 MeV (4 nucleons mein taqreeban 6.8 MeV per nucleon)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka 6.646786 × 10⁻²⁷ kg poore helium-4 atom (do electrons samet) ka mass hai, nucleus ka nahi. Helium-4 nucleus ka mass 6.6447 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai; is se Δm = 0.0504 × 10⁻²⁷ kg aur B.E ≈ 28.4 MeV banti hai (maani hui value 28.3 MeV, yani taqreeban 7.1 MeV per nucleon), 27 MeV nahi.

blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: kuch atomic masses

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table ¹H ka mass 1.007276 u deti hai; yeh proton ka mass hai. Hydrogen-1 atom ka mass 1.007825 u hai (table ke baqi masses bhi atoms ke hain), is liye yahan 1.007825 u likha gaya hai.
